integrity: A standalone finite consistency checker is included. Analytic infinite-length arguments and the cited theorem supply the proof; no independent validation or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The subshift is nontransitive; the finite word-count result is a polynomial upper and exponential lower bound, not an exact census. Critical equality uses Wu--Zhang Theorem A. The historical-priority comparison remains provisional; uncountably-many hereditary maximal-entropy measures and countably-many multialphabet examples were previously constructed.
title: Countably many maximal-entropy phases in a binary hereditary shift with a sharp forbidden-entropy boundary
